attribution_limitations: The Fig. 7 and Fig. 8 captions call the images postoperative views with a clear cornea, stable or well-centered lens and quiet anterior chamber, while the text cites Figs. 7 and 8 at the end of the operative description; the pixels show draped eyes held open with a wire lid speculum and blood-stained conjunctiva, consistent with on-table views at the end of surgery rather than a later postoperative visit.

Inline figure citations do not match the captions: the text cites Fig. 3-5 for the palate, nasal voice, arm span, arachnodactyly and the arm span-to-height ratio, while the captions assign Fig. 3 to arm span, Fig. 4 to the palate, Fig. 5 to pectus excavatum and Fig. 6 to arachnodactyly; the text then cites Fig. 6 for the scleral tunnel.
The laterality of the operated eye is not stated; the abstract describes bilateral cataracta pulverulenta and an operated eye.
The abstract describes severe bilateral diminution of vision while the case text describes marked visual impairment under bright light; the two wordings may describe one symptom.
